The role of '''crater-buster''' was one undertaken by the [[Boltrunian/Legends|Boltrunian]] [[Warto]] while working in the [[Tun Aduban]] [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]], where [[Gender/Legends|he]] hauled strong-boxes for those who were unable to hire the services of a [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|binary load lifter]].
